page.overview:
Who is Kokonowa?

Kokonowa is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. He and Ellerete are the members of the Passage of the Unbound who stole the Heartsting. Kokonowa is one of the antagonists during the Healer role quests in the Dawntrail expansion.

Ellerete and Kokonowa were among Apyaahi's guests who joined her villainous group. Although only Ellerete was present at the meeting, one of Kokonowa's mammets was accompanying her during the reunion. Apyaahi revealed the existence of sacred artifacts around Tural. These artifacts contain the essence of fearsome beasts called Tural Vidraal, and said that with the power of the artifacts they could achieve their goal..}}

Following Apyaahi's instructions, Ellerete and Kokonowa managed to infiltrate a village in northern Xak Tural and stole the Heartsting, a relic capable of controlling all types of toxins. When Nyipine and Loashkana left the village to recover the treasure, Ellerete and Kokonowa ambushed the two, and a mammet inflicted severe injuries on the Nyipine's foot. Escaping their pursuers, Ellerete and Kokonowa fled to Limsa Lominsa and began using the treasure to cause several incidents of blindness..}}

After successfully deceiving Wyssulm and Zerig into purchasing tainted potions in Aleport, Ellerete found immense amusement in watching Zerig suffer from uncontrollable hiccups due to the toxins. When Loashkana and the Warrior of Light arrived just in time to rescue the adventurers from danger, Ellerete made her dramatic appearance. She gleefully taunted her pursuers, taking pride in her role as an agent of chaos. With her characteristic flair, she introduced herself and Kokonowa, mocking the adventurers for their plight and boasting about her experiments with poisons. After toying with them long enough, she vanished into a cloud of foul smoke..}}
